Name: Powerful Tri Coffee
Author: stf7799
Description:
[size=4]This mod transforms the Triple Shot Espresso into an incredibly powerful beverage that provides substantial combat and skill enhancements. Perfect for miners heading deep into the Skull Cavern or combat enthusiasts taking on dangerous monsters!
Features
[/size]
[list]
[*]Enhanced Triple Shot Espresso with massively improved buffs
[*]+2 Speed (doubled from vanilla +1)
[*]+20 Attack for devastating combat performance
[*]+5 to All Skills (Combat, Farming, Fishing, Mining, Foraging, and Luck)
[*]+20 Magnetic Radius for easier item collection
[*]6-minute duration (same as vanilla)
[*]Maintains original price, appearance, and crafting requirements
[/list][size=4]Buff DetailsDrinking the enhanced Triple Shot Espresso now provides:[/size]

[list]
[*]⚔️ Combat Level: +5
[*]🌱 Farming Level: +5
[*]🎣 Fishing Level: +5
[*]⛏️ Mining Level: +5
[*]🌿 Foraging Level: +5
[*]🍀 Luck: +5
[*]🚀 Speed: +2
[*]⚔️ Attack: +20
[*]🧲 Magnetic Radius: +20
[/list]Compatibility

[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher
[*]Compatible with most other mods
[*]Does not affect other coffee items
[*]Maintains original item properties and localization
[/list]Notes

[list]
[*]Health and energy recovery remain unchanged to let other foods serve their purpose
[*]Perfect for late-game content and challenging modded gameplay
[*]Works seamlessly with existing save files
[/list]Brew yourself a cup of this supercharged coffee and conquer the Valley like never before!
